summary: This tutorial covers how to use JChemPaint, a chemical structures editor, to create and manipulate chemical structures. It begins by opening the JChemPaint window from a saved .jar file on the desktop using terminal commands. The tutorial explains how to access the periodic table trends feature and select elements using their symbols or names. It demonstrates creating a xenon difluoride (XeF2) molecule by adding bonds between atoms. The process of changing isotopes and altering element properties is also shown, with a shift from xenon to calcium as an example. The tutorial concludes by exploring different element categories within the periodic table.
